== Passive Ability: Stun ==
{{PAGENAME}}'s lightning attacks are able to stun enemies for a few seconds. Unlike other stunners like [[Packy (Maniac)]] or [[Jolyna (Determination)]], his stun is available, even at Upgrade 0, making him useful for emergency stuns for other units to have another chance of finishing them off.

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
